overall.summary: The proposed residential flat building is permitted with consent in the R3 zone and generally complies with the numerical controls of the LEP. However, as the site is within the Frenchs Forest Precinct (Site G), the development must exhibit design excellence as per clause 8.5(1)-(3). As this requires a design review panel assessment, consent cannot be granted until that assessment is completed.
